messages:
maria: heads-up — invoice preview showing a small but consistent credit bump for a subset of tenants after the routing-change canary. not sure if it's dedupe or route-attrib drift.
aj: which tenants? can you paste a sample tenant id & preview link?
maria: tenant: t-8f3a9, preview: https://console.redwood.infra/dashboards/invoice-preview?t=t-8f3a9 — spike started ~2024-02-09 14:10UTC (post-canary).
devon: saw something similar in shadow plane yesterday. suspect fanout ordering when route metadata enrichment is delayed.
sasha: quick question — are these credits flagged as fallback-route or original-route in the preview? that changes the dedupe logic.
maria: preview payload shows both route_tag=stable and route_tag=fallback in different event fragments, but same request_id.
aj: ingest-bot, can you dump the raw events for that request_id? (no PII, just routing headers + token counts)
ingest-bot: fetched 3 events for req=6b2c: 
```
[ {"ts":"1707707400","route":"stable","tokens":98},{"ts":"1707707412","route":"fallback","tokens":98},{"ts":"1707707430","route":"stable","tokens":0} ]
```
maria: that third event is weird (tokens:0). looks like a heartbeat or truncated ack?
devon: yep — we recently changed proxy retry to emit a low-cost probe event on route change, and our tallying logic treats any event with same request_id as additive unless dedupe-marker present.
sasha: so bug is dedupe-marker missing on probe events. fix options: 1) have proxy set dedupe=true on probe; 2) change tallyer to ignore events with tokens==0; 3) special-case route-tag transitions in postproc.
aj: option 2 is the fastest but brittle. option 1 requires proxy release and coordination with edge teams (longer). option 3 seems safest for now but is more work.
maria: UX concern — invoice-preview should reflect how final invoices will treat these. currently preview shows +98 tokens (double counted) and that confuses finance. we need preview-to-invoice parity.
devon: propose a short-term fix: postproc rule to collapse events with identical request_id within a 30s window if any event has tokens==0 (treat as probe). that would get parity in 1-2d.
sasha: agree, but add telemetry tags so we can alert if probes are generating real tokens accidentally.
aj: can someone draft the postproc PR and the proxy follow-up ticket? I'll schedule the proxy change in next sprint.
maria: I'll open the ticket for finance explaining the delta and mark the preview as "may include transient probe events" until fixed.
devon: PR sketch (in thread):
```
// in tally-postproc
if (events.within_window(req_id,30s).any(e => e.tokens==0)) {
  collapse(events.with(req_id))
  tag(result, "collapsed_probe_events")
}
```
sasha: nice. also emit metric: meter.postproc.collapsed_probe_events++ with route_tag and tenant. we can add a dashboard card.
aj: assign devon for PR, sasha for telemetry, maria for comms. I'll follow up with edge for proxy change. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks — will post status in #billing-ops once PR lands.
